title: CreateLdapProviderRequest
description: Create an LDAP Provider for account.

ldapProviderName.description: The name of LDAP provider to create.

url.description: The URL of the LDAP server. The URL must be prefixed with ldap:// or ldaps://. The URL can optionally specify a custom port, for example ldaps://ldap.example.org:663.

userSearchBase.description: Part of the directory tree under which to search for users. For example, ou=users,dc=example,dc=org.

userSearchFilter.description: The search filter to use for finding users. For example, (uid={{username}}).

groupSearchBase.description: The distinguished name indicating the path within the directory information tree to begin user searches from. For example, ou=groups,dc=example,dc=com.

groupSearchFilter.description: The search filter to use for finding groups for authorization of authenticated users.

usernameMappingAttribute.description: The LDAP displayName attribute name, will be used as the user's name. For example, uid, sAMAccountName.

bindDn.description: Bind DN. For example, uid=myapp,ou=users,dc=example,dc=org. Optional. Required if bind is not anonymous.

bindPassword.description: The password of the bind user.

userBindProperty.description: Property of the LDAP user object to use when binding to verify the password. For example, dn.

groupDnProperty.description: The property of user object to use in {{dn}} interpolation of groupSearchFilter.

emailMappingAttribute.description: The LDAP email attribute name, will be used as the user's email. For example, mail.

firstNameMappingAttribute.description: The LDAP attribute used as firstname , will be used as the user's firstname. For example, givenName.

lastNameMappingAttribute.description: The LDAP sn attribute name, will be used as the user's lastname. For example, sn.

groupNameMappingAttribute.description: The LDAP group attribute name, will be used as for user's group. For example, cn, name.

tlsCaCertificates.description: If the ldaps:// server uses a self-signed SSL certificate or a certificate issued by a private Certificate Authority (CA), then provide the trusted certificates that can be used to validate the LDAP server certificate.

startTls.description: Whether a start TLS request should be initiated on connecting to ldap.
